about: Suggest a new behavior or improvement

## Problem

What problem are you trying to solve? Frame this as a user need, not a
specific solution.

## Proposed solution

How do you think wuu should behave?

## Alternatives considered

What other approaches did you consider, and why is your proposed solution
better?

## Use case

A concrete scenario showing how you would use this feature. A short transcript
or screenshot helps.

## Additional context

Anything else worth knowing — related issues, prior art, or links to similar
behavior in other tools.
